note: Local author-registry overlay for the Duke DI build. The stomphacks ledger (third_party/stomphacks/ids/effect-authors.json) is gitignored and is clobbered by a re-clone or `git pull`, so our registered identity must live in OUR repo. tools/stage_build.sh merges these entries into the clone's ledger before invoking the build tool, which reads nickname->prefix from there (zd2_make_effect.py: author_prefix_table).
